**Finding: missing (INSURANCE) — fallback-level cure inserted.**

- **Investigation:** the only hit for "insurance" is in the § 1 net-revenue definition (a pricing deduction, not a covenant); § 14 Miscellaneous (14.1–14.10) and § 8.2 Indemnification contain no coverage obligation, and searches for maintain/coverage/policy/certificates returned nothing.
- **Direction:** Commerce One is the counterparty licensor/service provider (hosted BuySite, MarketSite Service, support contacts), so an insurance covenant burdens Vendor, not us.
- **Cure:** new § 14.11 inserted after 14.9, at the fallback threshold only — E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000. I deliberately omitted preferred-only items (CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates) and non-element boilerplate (at-own-expense, survival tail) so the change carries exactly the two selected elements.
